conclusions.canonical: No full A/root or proof/verification; all six A runs are incomplete. The physical stop after 33 groups without W commitment/AES setup shows this retained canonical state is not necessary for a component physical failure.
conclusions.numeric_pool: Selected for the exact inference caller: all tokens/copy traffic/fences unchanged and one-pair observed inference reduction 9.847%. A group timing reduction 0.148% is smaller than variation between repetitions; no stable A speedup demonstrated.
conclusions.physical_component_failure: Sampled 6,494,850,560 bytes over 6,174,015,488. Last GPU samples increase 496 MiB with constant host RSS and unchanged observed native maximum. No specific allocation/kernel/cache/leak attribution.
conclusions.public_zero_fill: Exact 3,840 application launches saved per matched A group, without changed allocations/copies/fences. The 0.323% observed A median reduction is smaller than between-run variation; retain the exact simplification, without selecting a stable wall-speedup claim.
